create_bulk_from_atoms: create a Bulk object by passing an ase.Atoms object directly to the constructor
create_bulk_from_db_index: create a Bulk object by selecting from the bulk database using bulk_id_from_db index
create_bulk_from_src_id: create a Bulk object by selecting from the bulk database using bulk_src_id_from_db like mp-30
create_bulk_random: create a Bulk object by randomly sampling from the bulk database with no arguments
get_slabs_from_bulk: get all possible slabs for a bulk instance using get_slabs with max_miller and precomputed_slabs_dir
